name: child-girl
desc: FRAMING: close half-body portrait cropped at the waist, head and shoulders filling most of the frame — not a full-length figure. A village girl of about eight with a candid open neutral expression: round face, gap-toothed, freckles across the nose, dark brown hair in two uneven plaits tied with scraps of red wool, a smudge of dirt on one cheek. She wears a faded cornflower-blue pinafore over a cream shirt, one sock slipping down, and carries a bundle of long grass and one very good stick. Halfway through a game she has not explained to anyone.
